title: Optimizing Unsupervised Clustering of Electrochemical Impedance Spectra via Normalization and Dimensionality Reduction
source_institution: University of Zagreb, Faculty of Chemical Engineering and Technology
electrochemical_system: Welded 316L stainless steel in aerated 0.1 M NaCl
selection_rationale: Independent institution and no overlap with the KAIRIS development corpus.
Corrosion and passivity domain complements the existing battery dataset.
Grouped physical conditions and high/low passivity references support blinded expert review without claiming causal ground truth.
